results.name: Kitchen Decor Pack
results.description:
Kitchen Decoration Pack – High-Quality 3D Asset Collection

This kitchen decoration pack includes a wide variety of realistic household items designed for interior rendering, game development, architectural visualization, and product presentations.
Inside the pack, you will find essential kitchen appliances such as a refrigerator, oven, stove, dishwasher, and small devices like a blender, air fryer, and toaster.

The set also includes a rich collection of props: spice jars, storage containers, fruits, cutting boards, cookbooks, utensils, cleaning supplies, wine bottles, cups, and more.
Each model is optimized for clean topology, efficient UV mapping, and PBR texturing, making it easy to use in any real-time engine (Unreal, Unity) or offline renderer (Cycles, V-Ray, Arnold).

Perfect for filling modern kitchen environments with realistic and detailed decoration assets.
Feel free to use these models in scenes, animations, architectural projects, or as ready-to-use assets in your asset library. 🍽️✨

results.name: - SNAQUE -
results.description:
Snaque - Wingless Birds Beneath the Kitchen Tiles

This project is an experiment in stylized art and animation created in Blender, inspired by an illustration by Alexandre Zedig Diboine.

Snaque are wingless birds that have chosen a cozy refuge beneath the kitchen tiles. Living hidden from the human world, they possess a unique ability to sense vibrations and sounds. The moment even the tiniest crumb hits the floor, they emerge from their shelter and rush toward the source.

Software: Blender
Style: Stylized / Cartoon
Inspiration: [Illustration by Alexandre Zedig Diboine](https://www.instagram.com/alexandrediboine/)
Focus: Character animation, exaggerated motion, personality
